meta.title: 不想带一堆衣服又想出片的，看这篇！

scenes.title_cn: 开场：行李越小越能出片
scenes.context: 博主用十余天行程证明：想拍出多套 look，关键不是带多少衣服，而是带对能任意组合的基础款。
sentences: 怎么带最少的衣服拍最多的片。
How to shoot the most looks with the least clothes.
look（造型）
这件事我太有发言权了。
I'm the right person to talk about this.
have a say（有发言权）
paraphrase: How to shoot the most looks with the least clothes.
用have a say换一种说法
I'm the right person to talk about this.
scenes.speak: How to shoot the most looks with the least clothes. I'm the right person to talk about this.

scenes.context: 带「有小设计」的基础款：白色T恤可以换成无袖蛋糕领或船领，白背心换成鱼骨背心，黑色背心换成交叉大肋背连体款。
sentences: 有小设计的基础款任意切换。
Basics with small details switch up easily.
basic（基础款）
下半身全部带基础款。
Everything on the bottom is a basic.
bottom（下半身）
整个一身显得简约又有质感。
The whole fit looks simple yet classy.
classy（有质感的）
基础款真的太不占地方。
Basics barely take up any space.
space（空间）
paraphrase: Basics with small details switch up easily.
Everything on the bottom is a basic.
The whole fit looks simple yet classy.
Basics barely take up any space.
scenes.speak: Basics with small details switch up easily. Everything on the bottom is a basic. The whole fit looks simple yet classy. Basics barely take up any space.

scenes.title_cn: 思路二：基础内搭+彩色罩衫
scenes.context: 基础款内搭加色彩强烈的罩衫，一件罩衫罩在上半身或围在下半身，就变成两套 look。
sentences: 带基础款内搭加彩色罩衫。
Pack basics plus a colorful topper.
topper（罩衫）
这个思路是我的命。
This trick is my life.
trick（妙招）
是不是又变成两套 look。
Now it's two looks out of one piece.
two looks（两套造型）
叠穿增加层次感。
Layer it to add depth.
layer（叠穿）
paraphrase: Pack basics plus a colorful topper.
Now it's two looks out of one piece.
scenes.speak: Pack basics plus a colorful topper. This trick is my life. Now it's two looks out of one piece. Layer it to add depth.

scenes.title_cn: 思路三：纯色基础+亮色设计款
scenes.context: 纯色基础款搭配有设计感的亮色单品：油画感鱼骨衣配白色短裙或牛仔裤，明艳又不显精致土。
sentences: 纯色基础加亮色设计款。
Pair a plain base with a loud piece.
loud（张扬的）
下面简单穿个白色短裙。
Keep it simple with a white skirt.
simple（简单的）
很明艳但不会显得精致土。
Bold, but not tacky.
tacky（土气的）
paraphrase: Pair a plain base with a loud piece.
Keep it simple with a white skirt.
scenes.speak: Pair a plain base with a loud piece. Keep it simple with a white skirt. Bold, but not tacky.

scenes.title_cn: 思路四：统一色调不同材质
scenes.context: 同一色调但材质不同：粉色纯棉T恤配缎面短裙或亮片裙，既有对比又和谐耐看。
sentences: 统一色调但不同材质。
One color family, different fabrics.
fabric（材质）
上身穿纯棉T恤，下身是缎面裙。
Cotton tee on top, satin skirt below.
satin（缎面）
有微微对比又很和谐。
A gentle contrast that still feels harmonious.
harmonious（和谐的）
paraphrase: Cotton tee on top, satin skirt below.
A gentle contrast that still feels harmonious.
scenes.speak: One color family, different fabrics. Cotton tee on top, satin skirt below. A gentle contrast that still feels harmonious.

scenes.title_cn: 思路五：成套设计感衣服
scenes.context: 直接买成套的设计感衣服：纯色基础款套装不用搭配就能撑起造型；挂脖背心拆开又能和其他单品组合出 double look。
sentences: 直接买成套的设计感衣服。
Just buy designed sets.
set（套装）
不需要再搭配就能撑起完整造型。
No matching needed to complete the outfit.
outfit（造型）
上下拆开又能搭配出 double look。
Separate the pieces for a double look.
double look（双造型）
paraphrase: No matching needed to complete the outfit.
Separate the pieces for a double look.
scenes.speak: Just buy designed sets. No matching needed to complete the outfit. Separate the pieces for a double look.

scenes.title_cn: 思路六：基础款靠配饰撑起
scenes.context: 基础款太素？用一个夸张的配饰去撑起整套 look：大包、民族包、双肩包、耳饰、头饰、墨镜、丝巾都能当点睛之笔。
sentences: 基础款就要多利用配饰。
Basics call for bold accessories.
accessory（配饰）
用一个夸张配饰撑起整套 look。
One bold piece carries the whole look.
bold（夸张的）
这套白衬衣全靠配饰撑起来。
This white shirt is carried entirely by accessories.
carry（撑起）
paraphrase: One bold piece carries the whole look.
This white shirt is carried entirely by accessories.
scenes.speak: Basics call for bold accessories. One bold piece carries the whole look. This white shirt is carried entirely by accessories.

scenes.context: 旅行本身就带大容量包，不妨选有设计感的：民族风大包撑风格，学院风配小双肩包，黑色背心配糖果色饺子包。
sentences: 选一个有设计感的大包。
Pick a big bag with some design.
design（设计感）
学院风可以配小双肩包。
Go academic with a small backpack.
backpack（双肩包）
黑色背心配糖果色饺子包。
A black tank with a candy-colored bag.
candy color（糖果色）
paraphrase: Pick a big bag with some design.
Go academic with a small backpack.
A black tank with a candy-colored bag.
scenes.speak: Pick a big bag with some design. Go academic with a small backpack. A black tank with a candy-colored bag.

scenes.title_cn: 配饰玩法：墨镜发饰皮带
scenes.context: 耳饰、发圈、头饰、墨镜、复古耳机、有造型感的帽子、logo丝巾都能改变基础款的氛围；金属感皮带增加运动健康感。
sentences: 大耳饰发圈头饰墨镜都行。
Earrings, hair ties, caps, shades—all work.
shades（墨镜）
复古耳机空壳子很便宜。
Vintage headphones come cheap as props.
prop（道具）
金属感皮带增加运动感。
A metal belt adds an athletic edge.
edge（锋芒）
paraphrase: Earrings, hair ties, caps, shades—all work.
Vintage headphones come cheap as props.
A metal belt adds an athletic edge.
scenes.speak: Earrings, hair ties, caps, shades—all work. Vintage headphones come cheap as props. A metal belt adds an athletic edge.

scenes.context: 分享结束，之后还会带来更多关于旅行穿搭和出片的内容。
sentences: 分享完了，下次见。
That's all for today—see you next time.
wrap-up（收尾）
之后还有更多旅行穿搭内容。
More travel styling content is on the way.
styling（穿搭）
paraphrase: That's all for today—see you next time.
More travel styling content is on the way.
scenes.speak: That's all for today—see you next time. More travel styling content is on the way.

小设计基础款不占地方还百搭
